summary: BridgeBio Pharma filed an 8-K reporting a material definitive agreement—an Investment Agreement for the issuance and sale of 933,900 shares of Series A Cumulative Convertible Participating Preferred Stock at $1,000/share, raising $933.9 million from Sixth Street and KKR-affiliated HCR Purchaser. The preferred stock carries a 7.00% cumulative dividend, is senior to common, convertible at $137.79/share, and includes an option for Sixth Street to provide up to $66.1 million more. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or activist campaign; it is a structured equity financing. No special-situation category applies; this is a routine capital raise.
